msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 4:3, referencia dolphins-bisuteria-05.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury campaign still life of colourful thread-wrapped bangles with brass caps and round coloured stones on a white wooden surface from the reference, arranged on pale travertine stone with soft late-afternoon sunlight and delicate shadows, the piece filling the centre-right of the frame, warm ivory tones, macro-sharp detail. One single continuous photograph. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia dolphins-bisuteria-04.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of thread-wrapped bangle bracelets in bright colours with brass caps and coloured stones from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia dolphins-bisuteria-01.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of animal print hair-on cowhide leather clutch bags in zebra, leopard and dalmatian, no logos from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia dolphins-bisuteria-17.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of chunky gold rings with big oval stones in turquoise, amber and red from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight.
